qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global leader in high-pressure plunger pumps and power take-offs with ~50% market shares and 22-24% EBITDA margins.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). World leader in high-pressure plunger pumps, but 75% of sales derive from cyclical hydraulics where commercial vehicle electrification poses a long-term threat to traditional mechanical transmission PTOs.
qualitative.evidence: Interpump maintains strong EBITDA margins (22-24%) and dominant niche positions, but capital intensity in hydraulics and goodwill from 40+ acquisitions depress GAAP ROIC toward 9-11%. Commercial vehicle powertrain transition away from diesel engines creates terminal runway friction.
